title: BC Friday Tips #75 Dynamics BC Excel Reports
summary: Excel Reports objects in Business Central belong to the Dynamics BC Excel Reports extension rather than the Base Application, requiring developers to add it as a dependency when extending these objects.
key_points: Excel Reports objects are part of the Dynamics BC Excel Reports extension, not the Base Application
Developers must add the extension as a dependency to extend these objects correctly
Knowing the source location helps developers find and extend objects properly

quotes.text: The Excel Reports objects are part of the Dynamics BC Excel Reports extension, not the Base Application.
quotes.why_it_matters: Understanding object locations is essential for developers to properly reference and extend features in Business Central.

quotes.text: If you want to extend those objects, you must add the extension as a dependency in your app.
quotes.why_it_matters: This clarifies the technical requirement for extending Excel Reports, ensuring developers follow correct implementation patterns.
